show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Muthu Muthiah - Inefficiency and Innovation at CHOA (EP. 339)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Muthu Muthiah is the Chief Investment Officer of Children's Healthcare of Atlanta (CHOA).
reader_summary.overview: Muthu Muthiah is the Chief Investment Officer of Children's Healthcare of Atlanta (CHOA), one of the largest pediatric clinical care providers in the U.S. Muthu stewards CHOA's $6 billion long term pool of capital, arriving a year ago after stints across a range of allocator seats the past twenty years. Our conversation covers Muthu's mobile upbringing, path to finance, and lessons learned working for a range of asset owners.

key_points.text: We discuss his first CIO seat at Inatai, where he oversaw a $2 billion portfolio starting with a clean sheet of paper.
